tokens.name: bg-canvas
tokens.usage: L0. The page ground behind everything. About 60% of any screen.

tokens.name: bg-raised
tokens.usage: L1. Panels that sit on the canvas: the feed, cards, kanban columns, sidebars. Always with a border-default frame.

tokens.name: bg-overlay
tokens.usage: L2 and L3. Menus, popovers, the job drawer and the command menu. Pair with shadow-l2 or shadow-l3.

tokens.name: bg-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill for rows, menu items and quiet buttons.

tokens.name: bg-active
tokens.usage: Pressed and selected fill: the selected feed row, the active nav item.

tokens.name: bg-inset
tokens.usage: Wells set into a surface: code blocks, kbd keys, the skeleton base.

tokens.name: border-subtle
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between rows and inside panels. Decorative; never the only cue for a control.

tokens.name: border-default
tokens.usage: The 1px frame on L1 to L3 surfaces.

tokens.name: border-control
tokens.usage: Borders that identify a control: inputs, checkboxes, secondary buttons, weak score badges. 3:1 or better on every surface.

tokens.name: border-control-hover
tokens.usage: Control border on hover.

tokens.name: text-primary
tokens.usage: Body text, job titles, headings. On any bg-* token.

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Supporting text: company, place, dates, helper text, inactive tabs. On any bg-* token.

tokens.name: text-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled labels only. Never for content people need to read.

tokens.name: accent-solid
tokens.usage: The signal fill (orange-9, #ff5a1f; in increased contrast a deep or light orange so its label reaches 7:1): primary button, my-companies star, the live dot, the logo cursor. Once or twice per screen.

tokens.name: accent-solid-hover
tokens.usage: Hover state of accent-solid: one step lighter in light, brighter in dark.

tokens.name: brand-signal
tokens.usage: The logo cursor and decorative cursor marks only, the same orange in every theme (logos are exempt from contrast rules). Never for text, controls or states: those use the accent tokens, which follow the theme.

tokens.name: accent-mark
tokens.usage: Small signal marks that must reach 3:1 on every row state: the my-companies star and the new-this-scan dot. A deeper orange in light, the signal itself in dark.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Links and accent text on any bg-* token or accent-subtle.

tokens.name: accent-subtle
tokens.usage: Tint behind accent text: the "New" chip, highlighted search matches.

tokens.name: accent-border
tokens.usage: Border paired with accent-subtle.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent-solid. Dark ink on the signal; light text on the deep orange of light increased contrast.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: The 2px focus outline, offset 2px, on every interactive element. 3:1 or better on every surface.

tokens.name: success-solid
tokens.usage: Strong match score fill; healthy board glyph.

tokens.name: success-text
tokens.usage: Strong match and healthy-board text on any bg-* token.

tokens.name: success-subtle
tokens.usage: Tint behind success-text.

tokens.name: on-success
tokens.usage: Digits on success-solid.

tokens.name: warning-solid
tokens.usage: Fair match score fill; dormant board glyph. Dark text on it.

tokens.name: warning-text
tokens.usage: Fair match and dormant-board text on any bg-* token.

tokens.name: warning-subtle
tokens.usage: Tint behind warning-text.

tokens.name: on-warning
tokens.usage: Digits on warning-solid. Always dark.

tokens.name: danger-solid
tokens.usage: Small status glyphs only (dead board). Never a large fill or a button background.

tokens.name: danger-text
tokens.usage: Errors, broken links, destructive action labels and their outline.

tokens.name: danger-subtle
tokens.usage: Tint behind an inline error message.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Behind the job drawer and command menu.

tokens.name: button-primary-bg
tokens.usage: Primary button fill. Component token: alias of accent-solid.

tokens.name: button-primary-bg-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button hover. Component token: alias of accent-solid-hover.

tokens.name: button-primary-fg
tokens.usage: Primary button label. Component token: alias of on-accent.

tokens.name: button-secondary-bg
tokens.usage: Secondary button fill. Component token: alias of bg-raised.

tokens.name: button-secondary-border
tokens.usage: Secondary button border. Component token: alias of border-control.

tokens.name: button-secondary-fg
tokens.usage: Secondary button label. Component token: alias of text-primary.

tokens.name: button-secondary-bg-hover
tokens.usage: Secondary button hover fill. Component token: alias of bg-hover.

tokens.name: button-quiet-fg
tokens.usage: Quiet button label at rest. Component token: alias of text-secondary.

tokens.name: button-quiet-fg-hover
tokens.usage: Quiet button label on hover. Component token: alias of text-primary.

tokens.name: button-quiet-bg-hover
tokens.usage: Quiet button hover fill. Component token: alias of bg-hover.

tokens.name: button-danger-bg-hover
tokens.usage: Destructive button hover fill. Component token: alias of danger-subtle.

tokens.name: button-danger-fg
tokens.usage: Destructive button label and border (outline style, no fill). Component token: alias of danger-text.

tokens.name: input-bg
tokens.usage: Text field and select fill. Component token: alias of bg-raised.

tokens.name: input-border
tokens.usage: Text field border at rest. Component token: alias of border-control.

tokens.name: input-border-hover
tokens.usage: Text field border on hover. Component token: alias of border-control-hover.

tokens.name: feed-bg
tokens.usage: The Radar feed panel. Component token: alias of bg-raised.

tokens.name: feed-row-hover
tokens.usage: Feed row on hover and keyboard focus. Component token: alias of bg-hover.

tokens.name: feed-row-selected
tokens.usage: The feed row whose drawer is open. Component token: alias of bg-active.

tokens.name: feed-divider
tokens.usage: Hairline between feed rows. Component token: alias of border-subtle.

tokens.name: feed-row-selected-bar
tokens.usage: The 2px bar on the left edge of the selected row, so selection is not shown by fill alone. Component token: alias of text-primary.

tokens.name: feed-section-bg
tokens.usage: Section header strip inside the feed (My companies, Everyone else). Component token: alias of bg-canvas.

tokens.name: score-strong-bg
tokens.usage: Strong score badge fill. Component token: alias of success-solid.

tokens.name: score-strong-fg
tokens.usage: Strong score badge digits. Component token: alias of on-success.

tokens.name: score-fair-bg
tokens.usage: Fair score badge fill. Component token: alias of warning-solid.

tokens.name: score-fair-fg
tokens.usage: Fair score badge digits. Component token: alias of on-warning.

tokens.name: score-weak-fg
tokens.usage: Weak score badge digits (outlined, no fill). Component token: alias of text-secondary.

tokens.name: score-weak-border
tokens.usage: Weak score badge outline. Component token: alias of border-control.

tokens.name: score-strong-estimated
tokens.usage: Estimated strong score: dashed outline and digits. Component token: alias of success-text.

tokens.name: score-fair-estimated
tokens.usage: Estimated fair score: dashed outline and digits. Component token: alias of warning-text.

tokens.name: breakdown-track
tokens.usage: Empty part of a score breakdown segment. Component token: alias of bg-active.

tokens.name: breakdown-track-border
tokens.usage: Inset 1px outline on each segment, so the unearned share reads at 3:1. Component token: alias of border-control.

tokens.name: breakdown-fill
tokens.usage: Earned part of a score breakdown segment. Component token: alias of text-primary.

tokens.name: star
tokens.usage: The my-companies star. Component token: alias of accent-mark.

tokens.name: live-dot
tokens.usage: Dot on jobs first seen in the latest scan. Component token: alias of accent-mark.

tokens.name: drawer-bg
tokens.usage: Job drawer surface. Component token: alias of bg-overlay.

tokens.name: kbd-bg
tokens.usage: Keyboard key fill. Component token: alias of bg-inset.

tokens.name: kbd-border
tokens.usage: Keyboard key border. Component token: alias of border-default.

tokens.name: kbd-fg
tokens.usage: Keyboard key label. Component token: alias of text-secondary.

tokens.name: chip-bg
tokens.usage: Filter chip fill when off. Component token: alias of bg-raised.

tokens.name: chip-border
tokens.usage: Filter chip frame when off. Component token: alias of border-default.

tokens.name: chip-fg
tokens.usage: Filter chip label when off. Component token: alias of text-secondary.

tokens.name: chip-on-bg
tokens.usage: Filter chip fill when on (inverted). Component token: alias of text-primary.

tokens.name: chip-on-fg
tokens.usage: Filter chip label when on. Component token: alias of bg-raised.

tokens.name: tab-fg
tokens.usage: Tab label when not selected. Component token: alias of text-secondary.

tokens.name: tab-fg-selected
tokens.usage: Selected tab label. Component token: alias of text-primary.

tokens.name: tab-indicator
tokens.usage: The 2px underline under the selected tab. Component token: alias of text-primary.

tokens.name: progress-track
tokens.usage: Scan progress track. Component token: alias of bg-active.

tokens.name: progress-fill
tokens.usage: Scan progress fill. Component token: alias of text-primary.

tokens.name: skeleton-bg
tokens.usage: Skeleton bar base. Component token: alias of bg-inset.

tokens.name: skeleton-shine
tokens.usage: Skeleton shimmer highlight: lighter than the bar in light themes (bg-raised over bg-inset), bg-hover in dark ones. Light can't use bg-hover: it's the same sand-3 as the bar, so the shimmer wouldn't show.

tokens.name: toast-bg
tokens.usage: Toast fill (inverted). Component token: alias of text-primary.

tokens.name: toast-fg
tokens.usage: Toast text, its Undo button and its focus ring. Component token: alias of bg-raised.

tokens.name: menu-bg
tokens.usage: Menu and popover surface. Component token: alias of bg-overlay.

tokens.name: menu-item-hover
tokens.usage: Hovered or focused menu item. Component token: alias of bg-hover.

tokens.name: column-bg
tokens.usage: Pipeline column. Component token: alias of bg-raised.

tokens.name: card-bg
tokens.usage: Pipeline card. Component token: alias of bg-overlay.

families.mono: "Geist Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace

groups.name: Interface
groups.note: Geist, weights 400 / 500 / 600 only. Major Second scale from a 16px body. Sentence case. Nothing below 12px.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Page titles in the dashboard. One per screen.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Drawer title, section headings, empty-state headlines.

styles.name: subheading
styles.usage: Group headings inside a panel or drawer.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Acme is hiring a product lead for its regulated exchange in Abu Dhabi.
styles.usage: Job descriptions and running text. Max 70ch per line.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Job titles in feed rows and kanban cards.

styles.name: small
styles.sample: Acme · Abu Dhabi, Dubai · Hybrid · 2 days ago
styles.usage: Meta lines under titles, settings descriptions, helper text, table cells.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Buttons, tabs, form labels, menu items.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Timestamps, counts, footnotes, tooltips. Never for primary content.

styles.name: score
styles.usage: Digits inside score badges. Tabular figures (font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums).

styles.name: score-lg
styles.usage: The score at the top of the job drawer. Tabular figures.

groups.name: Marketing
groups.note: Landing page and README only. Never inside the dashboard.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: The landing page's one hero headline: 40px on phones, growing with the window to 88px.

styles.name: display
styles.sample: Your next role may already be on a careers page.
styles.usage: Big marketing type below the hero: the closing headline and the numbers in the proof strip. 36px on phones, 48px on desktop.

styles.name: section
styles.sample: A score you can argue with
styles.usage: Marketing section headings (h2): 28px on phones, 40px on desktop.

styles.name: lede
styles.usage: The sentence under the hero headline.

groups.name: Source
groups.note: Geist Mono for what came from a machine: hiring system names, slugs, URLs, keys and CLI.

styles.name: source
styles.usage: Source tags. Set uppercase; the only uppercase in the system.

styles.name: kbd
styles.usage: Keyboard keys in tooltips, menus and the shortcut sheet.

spacing.note: 8px grid for layout, 4px steps for gaps inside a component.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label; glyph to digits in a badge.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside chips and badges; between meta items; button icon gap.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Feed row vertical padding (comfortable density).

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel and row horizontal padding; phone page gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between groups inside a panel; drawer padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Desktop page gutter; between panels.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Between landing page sections.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Landing hero padding only.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Feed rows and breakdown segments. Raw data is square.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Score badges, source tags, chips, kbd keys.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, panels, the drawer, menus. The largest radius in the system.

tokens.name: radius-dot
tokens.usage: The live dot only. Nothing else is round.

shadow.note: Borders carry elevation; shadows only soften L2 and L3. Light-mode alpha stays under 0.08. Dark mode uses a top-edge highlight instead of a drop shadow.

tokens.name: shadow-l1
tokens.usage: L1 panels (feed, cards). Light: border only.

tokens.name: shadow-l2
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, tooltips.

tokens.name: shadow-l3
tokens.usage: The job drawer and command menu, over the scrim.

duration.note: Four durations only. Enter eases out, exit eases in. Animate transform and opacity only.

tokens.name: duration-instant
tokens.usage: Hover, press and focus feedback.

tokens.name: duration-quick
tokens.usage: Exits: closing the drawer, dismissing a menu or toast.

tokens.name: duration-base
tokens.usage: Enters: opening the drawer, menus, popovers; a new row arriving.

tokens.name: duration-slow
tokens.usage: Full-screen drawer on phones only.

tokens.name: duration-story
tokens.usage: Marketing pages only: one step of the hero load or the route animation, so the eye can follow it. Never in the dashboard.

tokens.name: ease-enter
tokens.usage: Things arriving: fast start, soft landing.

tokens.name: ease-exit
tokens.usage: Things leaving: soft start, quick exit.

tokens.name: ease-standard
tokens.usage: Color and opacity changes on the spot.

size.note: Control heights and density. Comfortable is the default; compact is a user setting.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Inline row actions and chips that act as filters.

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs and selects.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: Primary actions on phones; the minimum touch target.

tokens.name: row-pad-comfortable
tokens.usage: Feed row vertical padding, comfortable density (row about 72px).

tokens.name: row-pad-compact
tokens.usage: Feed row vertical padding, compact density (row about 64px).

tokens.name: drawer-width
tokens.usage: Job drawer width on desktop; full width under 720px.

tokens.name: prose-max
tokens.usage: Maximum line length for job descriptions and docs.

tokens.name: z-sticky
tokens.usage: Sticky feed header and toolbar.

tokens.name: z-menu
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, tooltips.

tokens.name: z-drawer
tokens.usage: The job drawer and its scrim.

tokens.name: z-modal
tokens.usage: Command menu and confirmation dialogs.

tokens.name: z-toast
tokens.usage: Toasts.
